page.overview:
What is Phineas Black?

Phineas Black was a pure-blood wizard, the second eldest son of Phineas Nigellus Black and his wife Ursula Flint, and brother of Sirius, Arcturus, Belvina and Cygnus Black.

He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during his father's tenure as Headmaster, alongside his older brother Sirius. He was disowned for supporting Muggle rights and removed from the Black family tree.

The name Phineas has roots in the biblical name [https://www.behindthename.com/name/phinehas Phinehas]. This is the given name of the grandson of Aaron (who was the brother of Moses and first high priest of the Israelites), who stops a plague from God. The other known Phinehas was the son of Eli, and was killed in battle against the Philistines. The name Phineas is a variant of the name found in the Old Testament.
